objective.text: Name a card's three steps, in order.

body.general: How do you really learn a card? Each card teaches one idea [f1]. Keep it open for a moment, and it counts as Read [f2]. Pass its Check, every question right in one go, and it is Understood [f3]. Then explain it out loud and compare with the model answer: that is Can explain [f4]. Try it lets you turn the 3D embryo and scrub through the days [f5]. Your Remember deck brings the card's prompts back 1 day later, then 3, then 7 days apart [f6].
body.mbbs: Each card teaches one idea and opens with what you will be able to do [f1]. Keeping a card open for a moment marks it Read [f2]. Its Check tests that objective; every question right in one run marks it Understood [f3]. Explaining it aloud, then comparing with the model answer, marks it Can explain [f4]. Try it opens the card's 3D scene: turn it and scrub the days; Open full 3D adds slicing [f5]. The card's Remember prompts join your deck once you read it [f6]. They come back 1 day later, then 3, then 7 days apart while you get them right [f6]. Today shows how many prompts are due [f7]. The small numbers after a sentence open its facts, each with a source and a confidence mark [f8].

facts.text: Each card teaches one idea and opens with what you will be able to do.
A card counts as Read once it has been open for a moment (1.5 s).
Getting every question of a card's Check right in one run marks the card Understood.
After Understood, you explain the idea out loud and compare with a model answer to mark it Can explain.
Try it shows the card's 3D scene, which you can turn and scrub through the days; Open full 3D adds slicing.
A card's Remember prompts join your deck when you read it. They come back 1 day later, then 3, then every 7 days while you get them right.
Today shows how many Remember prompts are due.
The small number after a sentence opens the facts behind it, each with its source and confidence mark.
Watch it will link each card to its episode; until episodes exist it says Coming soon.
A missed prompt that was due comes back the next day and starts its spacing again. Any miss also repeats once at the end of that session.

misconceptions.wrong: Once you have read a card, you have learned it.
misconceptions.right: Read is only the first step: pass the Check, then explain it in your own words.
